body:
## What's Changed
* Fix negative --users causing infinite hang in headless mode by @reachsridhard in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3509
* Fix web UI user count not persisting in parsed_options by @saiyaswanth883 in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3517
* chore: add RUF ruff rules by @even-even in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3519
* Decode percent-encoded credentials in host URL and keep IPv6 brackets in base_url by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3520
* Fix FastHttpUser allow_redirects=False on geventhttpclient 2.5+ by @saiyaswanth883 in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3526
* Fix negative user_count validation in /swarm endpoint by @suraj-self in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3523
* Fix constant pacing after wall-clock adjustments by @Shubham-Padkonde in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3524
* Reject a non-positive spawn_rate in new_dispatch() by @Lesereingrape in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3528
* Reject a non-positive rate in constant_throughput() by @Lesereingrape in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3534
* Fix format_duration() truncating each timestamp before subtracting by @Lesereingrape in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3536
* Add request_name and rename_request to FastHttpSession by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3532
* chore: up min requests version to 2.33.1 and delete if-else requests by @even-even in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3521
* Reject a negative spawn_rate in /swarm instead of reporting a successful start by @Lesereingrape in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3538
* Do not modify the headers dict the caller passed in by @Lesereingrape in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3530

## New Contributors
* @saiyaswanth883 made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3517
* @SulimanAbdulrazzaq made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3520
* @Shubham-Padkonde made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3524
* @Lesereingrape made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3528

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/locustio/locust/compare/2.46.6...2.46.7
